review.note: Retracted in M21 as unidentifiable from the material here. The import got no label, no description and no cached lead for this item — the record is titled with its own Wikidata id. What it holds is a date and a place, 28 May 1922 at Macau, which points strongly at the shooting of Chinese demonstrators and the general strike that followed. Pointing is not knowing, and the atlas does not write a record on an inference about what an item probably is.
